verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list support for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Web, iOS and Android, so one project can target desktop and mobile. A community comment adds that Bevy runs well on iOS. Nothing in the pack mentions console export, either directly or via partners. missing for 10: console export (direct or via partners), documented export/packaging workflow per platform, independent corroboration of Android and desktop builds.

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Support for all major platforms: Windows, MacOS, Linux, Web, iOS, Android
Bevy runs well on iOS currently
